episodes.title: Chapter 1: The Hidden People
episodes.summary: Tiny, invisible people threaten Hilda's fun and adventurous life in the wilderness with her mother and pet deer-fox, Twig.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: The Midnight Giant
episodes.summary: Hilda reaches out to a sad and lonely giant while her mum, worried about the threats they've received, mulls over a move to the city of Trolberg.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: The Bird Parade
episodes.summary: Encouraged by her mother to make new friends on the playground, Hilda instead buddies up to an injured bird who's lost his memory.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: The Sparrow Scouts
episodes.summary: After joining the Sparrow Scouts, Hilda partners with new pals Frida and David to clean up a park, little realizing what's lurking underground.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: The Troll Rock
episodes.summary: On parent-teacher night, Hilda springs into action when she discovers David's pet rock project hides a dangerous secret.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: The Nightmare Spirit
episodes.summary: When David blames his nightmares on Hilda and her hair-raising exploits, she decides to try and help him face his fears.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: The Lost Clan
episodes.summary: On a quest to earn their Sparrow Scouts botany badges, Hilda, David and Frida make a surprising discovery when they search for a rare plant.

episodes.title: Chapter 8: The Tide Mice
episodes.summary: Hilda realizes the importance of being detail-oriented when she casts a spell from a book of enchantments -- and fails to read the fine print.

episodes.title: Chapter 9: The Ghost
episodes.summary: Frida's messy room and missing book lead the gang on a ghost hunt that ends up putting their growing friendship to the test.

episodes.title: Chapter 10: The Storm
episodes.summary: When her favorite radio weather reporter goes silent amid a raging blizzard, Hilda decides to investigate, with David and the Raven in tow.

episodes.title: Chapter 11: The House in the Woods
episodes.summary: Alone and lost in the wilderness, Hilda bumps into an old friend and asks for help getting home. Back in Trolberg, her worried mum looks for her.

episodes.title: Chapter 12: The Nisse
episodes.summary: On the eve of an overnight camping trip, Hilda tries to help a down-and-out house spirit. Frida makes new friends. A mysterious beast prowls Trolberg.

episodes.title: Chapter 13: The Black Hound
episodes.summary: As fear grips the city over the Black Hound, Hilda makes it her mission to help Tontu, even if it means having less time to earn Sparrow Scout badges.

episodes.title: Chapter 1: The Troll Circle
episodes.summary: Hilda's essay about her close encounter with a troll wins her the chance to tag along with Trolberg's new head of the safety patrol, Erik Ahlberg.

episodes.title: Chapter: 2: The Draugen
episodes.summary: A quest to uncover secret information about Ahlberg leads Hilda on a high-seas adventure with the Wood Man that lands them in a boatload of trouble.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: The Witch
episodes.summary: After Hilda and Frida come across a magical portal at the library, they must team up with the librarian in a race against time to find a missing book.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: The Eternal Warriors
episodes.summary: David confronts his many fears when he stumbles into a ferocious battle during an overnight Sparrow Scouts camping trip with Hilda and Frida.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: The Windmill
episodes.summary: On a bird-watching expedition, Hilda, Frida and David run into meteorologist Victoria Van Gale, whose calm new life makes one of them very suspicious.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: The Old Bells of Trolberg
episodes.summary: Chaos comes to Trolberg when the bell system begins to ring every hour, inspiring Hilda and friends to hatch an elaborate scheme to quiet the noise.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: The Beast of Cauldron Island
episodes.summary: Hilda and Frida launch an in-depth investigation to prove the fire-breathing resident of Cauldron Island isn't responsible for a wave of boat attacks.

episodes.title: Chapter 8: The Fifty Year Night
episodes.summary: Hilda learns all too well that actions have consequences after she discovers a way to travel back in time — and decides to make a few changes.

episodes.title: Chapter 9: The Deerfox
episodes.summary: After Hilda's deer-fox companion Twig leaves home and runs into the wilderness, Hilda and her mum set off on a search that stirs bittersweet memories.

episodes.title: Chapter: 10: The Yule Lads
episodes.summary: On their way to Trolberg's Winter Festival, Hilda, Frida and David come across a group of odd little fellows who are on the hunt for naughty kids.

episodes.title: Chapter 11: The Jorts Incident
episodes.summary: Hilda and pals gear up for a magical mission: to reverse an enchantment that's taken over the headquarters of the local snack food company, Jorts.

episodes.title: Chapter 12: The Replacement
episodes.summary: Desperate times call for desperate measures as Alfur faces questions from the Elf Kingdom over his exciting reports from Trolberg.

episodes.title: Chapter 13: The Stone Forest
episodes.summary: Hilda, her mum and Twig look for a way out of a mysterious forest full of trolls, while a worried David and Frida journey out of Trolberg to find them.

episodes.title: Chapter 1: The Train to Tofoten
episodes.summary: Hilda and the gang take the train to Tofoten to visit Great-Aunt Astrid for a relaxing holiday — but adventure soon comes knocking at their door.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: The Fairy Mound
episodes.summary: Convinced that fairies exist in Tofoten, Hilda starts investigating around town... only to uncover a troubling mystery involving her own family.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: The Giantslayer
episodes.summary: An ancient Faratok Tree transports Hilda and Wood Man to an alternate universe, where a feud rages between giants and a not-so-mighty giantslayer.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: The Laughing Merman
episodes.summary: After their fellow Sparrow Scouts dub them "The Freaky Friends," Hilda, Frida and David resolve to have the most ordinary river trip imaginable.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: The Job
episodes.summary: When Hilda's father comes for a surprise visit, she joins him on a mysterious errand to the castle ruins on behalf of a shady man known as "The Polecat."

episodes.title: Chapter 6: The Forgotten Lake
episodes.summary: Hilda and her mother go on a camping trip, but Johanna suspects she's visited this forest before. Does the forest remember her, too?

episodes.title: Chapter 7: Strange Frequencies
episodes.summary: Frida holds a town hall meeting to figure out why the nisse keep stealing from each other while Hilda tries to decode her radio's cryptic messages.

episodes.title: Chapter 8: The Fairy Isle
episodes.summary: Hilda journeys into the fairy mound to look for her father, unraveling surprising family secrets along the way — but the truth comes at a great risk.
